_readme: Landing page content that is not course data. Teacher and testimonial blocks were removed rather than shipped as placeholders; add them back only when there are real people and real photographs. Never invent a testimonial: the audience is scam-targeted and the product teaches scam avoidance.

faq.a: You will learn practical ways to use AI in daily life: asking better questions, writing messages and letters, planning tasks, and checking information safely.

faq.q: Do I need to know English or technology?
faq.a: No. You can start with the words you already use. The lessons use simple language and show each step on a phone.

faq.q: Do I need experience with AI?
faq.a: No. We start with the basics, explain what AI can and cannot do, and build one small skill at a time.
Most lessons take about five or six minutes. Each one teaches one useful idea that you can try on your own phone.

faq.q: Is it safe to use AI?
faq.a: AI can be useful, but it can also make mistakes. We show you what to check and remind you never to share an OTP, UPI PIN, password, or private document.

faq.q: Do I need an account to begin?
faq.a: No. Start with the free lessons without an account. Sign in only when you want Kettle to remember where you stopped.
